subject: regarding the map construction and QTL analysis in NAM population

messages.author: 9af7c0e584af0222
messages.subject: regarding the map construction and QTL analysis in NAM population
parts:
Hi Karl,
We have a NAM population with 4 families. We developed the genetic map in JoinMap by considering all four families as a single RIL population. But while doing QTL analysis PVE% is coming like 300 and 400% which is because of nonuniformity of polymorphism across the families. eg. suppose "X" is a SNP which is monomorphic in family 1 (allele A) and same SNP giving monomorphism in another family with (allele B). I mean the markers which we are considering as polymorphic markers are not polymorphic in the family, they are polymorphic between the families. How to deal with such sort of data? 

Please help in this issue Karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] regarding the map construction and QTL analysis in NAM population
parts:
I don't fully understand the 300-400% PVE. Can you should some example
output?

I don't think R/qtl is able to handle this case properly. Maybe look at
TASSEL? http://www.maizegenetics.net/tassel

karl
